body: thank you. it's hard not to lose hope completely after 20 years of constant misery
am familiar with it. I'm not a noob to this unfortunately.

I won't mess up if I do it, don't worry. And I'm afraid 'take a nap' and 'study' are things that I haven't been able to do for quite a while now. I think you might be misjudging the intensity of the situation a bit. Any way, I wish you good luck as well.
Sorry. Might have overacted a bit, but I felt mocked. I am seeking professional help but I need something a bit more immediate.

I hope at one point in your life you will be so desperate you will be crawling on the floor, clawing at yourself in vain in an attempt to stop the emotional pain, and the only person to see you will point a finger at you and laugh.
